response.sql: SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE a.date >= '1994-06-17' AND a.date <= '1996-09-02' GROUP BY d.A3

assumptions.assumption: account.date is stored as ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD', so comparing it as text against '1994-06-17' and '1996-09-02' (inclusive) selects the intended range, even though the documentation describes the format as YYMMDD.
An inner join to district drops accounts whose district_id is not in the district table. The request asks for exactly this.
